_README: Copy this file to <configDir>/config.json (default ~/.jamat-v3) and edit it. Each top-level key below is a section with one owner, which writes that key and nothing else; keys this build does not know are preserved on save, so editing by hand is safe. Override the config directory with JAMAT_V3_CONFIG_DIR.
_README_fileChanges: Which version control system File Changes prefers when both Git and SVN are available. The section may be left out, which is the same as git.
_README_ui: Text size, as a percentage of this build's own sizes. 100 is the default appearance, the range is 70 to 150 and the step is 5; a number off that grid is snapped to it rather than thrown away. fontScalePercent is everything the window draws except the status bar, fileViewerFontScalePercent multiplies it again inside a file viewer's document, and terminalFontScalePercent is the terminal alone. terminalTheme is which colours the terminal paints in: 'original' takes the window's own background and text, 'soft' the Windows Terminal pair V1 used, 'vscodeDark' the VS Code Dark palette; a name outside those three is reported and read as 'original'. The whole section may be left out, which is the same as the values below.
_README_remarkable: Connection settings for the reMarkable tablet. host and fingerprint stay absent until explicitly configured; fingerprint must be the verified SHA256 value shown by the tablet. timeoutMilliseconds accepts 1000 through 600000 and defaults to 180000. The password is encrypted in machine-local state through the operating system and must never be written here.
_README_agents: Per agent, what a session starts with when nothing overrides it. yolo skips the agent's own permission prompts and is off for both until somebody turns it on. model and effort are ABSENT by default, and absent is a real value: no flag is emitted and the agent starts on whatever it defaults to itself, which may be something the user set in the agent's own config. A model name must start alphanumeric so it can never be read as a flag by the CLI it is handed to. The whole section may be left out, which is the same as the values below.
_README_remoteControl: Controlling this computer from another one, and reaching others from here. It is OFF until listener.enabled is set, and pairing a peer needs a dialog somebody clicks on this machine - never a flag in this file. All four listener keys are REQUIRED whenever the section is present: one of them missing makes the whole section damaged, and a damaged section reads as switched off with no peers, which looks exactly like a listener that was never turned on. bindHost is the address the socket takes (0.0.0.0 is every interface); advertisedHost is what a paired computer is told to dial, so on a real network it must be this machine's LAN or VPN address rather than the 127.0.0.1 shown here. Editing it by hand is not the intended path: the Remote Control tab writes it, and a profile carries key material this file then holds. Read docs/architecture/remote-control.md and docs/runbooks/remote-lan-vpn.md before touching it. The whole section may be left out, which is the same as switched off with no peers.

categories._README_id: Stable and unique. Everything else refers to a category by this, so the label can be renamed freely without orphaning anything.
categories._README_label: What a human sees. Not a key.
categories.label: NodeJs
categories._README_path: The root directory scanned for projects. A project is any directory one level below it; no marker file is required. Written the way you spell it - only comparisons are normalized.
categories._README_hiddenFolders: Names never listed as projects. Directories starting with a dot and the literal 'Archived' are always hidden and need no entry.
categories._README_flattenFolders: Containers expanded one level deeper, so their children are listed as 'container/child'.
categories._README_virtualFolders: Display-only grouping by name prefix. 'temporaryFoo' groups under prefix 'temporary'; a prefix ending in '-' or '_' matches without the capital-letter rule.
categories._README_afterCreate: Run once in a newly created project directory while it is still empty. {dir} and {name} are substituted. A failure is reported, not fatal.
